{"id":1135,"status":"Fixed","summary":"Variable names prefixed with MSG_ cause error with advanced optimizations","labels":["Type-Defect","Priority-Medium"],"stars":0,"commentCount":8,"comments":[{"id":0,"commenterId":-3325454697554823320,"content":"Variables named something with MSG_ seem to cause problems with the module system, even if no modules are used in the code.

$ echo "var MSG_foo='bar'" | closure --compilation_level ADVANCED_OPTIMIZATIONS
stdin:1: ERROR - message not initialized using goog.getMsg
var MSG_foo='bar'
    ^

It works fine with msg_foo, MSG2_foo, etc.","timestamp":1384264447,"attachments":[]},{"id":1,"commenterId":8173196008570380122,"content":"It actually isn't modules related at all but has to do with goog.getMsg call replacements. The compiler is using the prefix 'MSG_' internally - which is conflicting with your variable names.

It seems to me like the compiler should use a prefix less likely to collide with user prefixes. Something like 'JSCompiler_MSG_'. However I'm unsure of the impact this would have on internal Google projects. But if this is the case, then the prefix should be moved to a coding convention at a minimum.","timestamp":1384267193,"attachments":[]},{"id":2,"commenterId":-3325454697554823320,"content":"Ok. Prefixing internal names with __ would make sense since that's usually used to indicate an implementation/browser-level identifier. So perhaps __JSCompiler_MSG_*.","timestamp":1384267489,"attachments":[]},{"id":3,"commenterId":-7699928860083865744,"content":"Chad has a misunderstanding. The way closure-compiler's translation system works is that it looks for all variables with the name MSG_ and tries to translate them. It is complaining here that the message is not formatted correctly for translation.

The real bug is that advanced optimizations turns on translation.","timestamp":1384272979,"attachments":[]},{"id":4,"commenterId":8173196008570380122,"content":"@Nick I suspected as much - but I still think that prefix should be set by the coding convention and not hard-coded into the pass.","timestamp":1384277211,"attachments":[]},{"id":5,"commenterId":-7699928860083865744,"content":"fix posted here:
